transcript: Speaker A: Sir, second AC mein kaise jana hai? [Sir, how to go to second AC?] Speaker B: Go straight this way, and after two compartments, you'll reach the second AC coach. Speaker A: Sir samjha nahi, English ache se nahi aati. [Sir, didn't understand, I don't know English well.] Speaker B: Are, aaj kal ke zamane mein English seekhna to bahut important hai. Seekh kyun nahi lete ho? [Oh, in today's world, learning English is very important. Why don't you learn?] Speaker A: Sir mere paas time kahan hai? Aapne kahan se seekha? [Sir, where do I have time? Where did you learn from?] Speaker B: Maine to Speakeasy app se seekha hai, aur zyada time ki koi zaroorat nahi hai. Is app par bas 10-15 minute practice karo, and your English will get better in some days. [I learned from the Speakeasy app, and there's no need for much time. Just practice for 10-15 minutes on this app, and your English will get better in some days.] Speaker A: Ye Speakeasy app kya hai? [What is this Speakeasy app?] Speaker B: Is app mein Vani AI teacher hai, jiske saath tum bina kisi judgment ke English practice kar sakte ho. Aur best part ye hai ki galti karoge to AI turant correct bhi kar deti hai. [In this app, there is Vani AI teacher, with whom you can practice English without any judgment. And the best part is, if you make a mistake, the AI corrects you immediately.] Speaker A: Par sir, ye app to mehenga hoga na? [But sir, this app must be expensive, right?] Speaker B: Bilkul nahi, maine to bas ek rupee mein shuru kiya tha. Tum bhi kar sakte ho. [Not at all, I started for just one rupee. You can too.] Speaker A: Kaise start karun? [How do I start?] Speaker B: Bas install button pe click karo, Speakeasy app install karo, and apni English learning journey shuru karo. [Just click on the install button, install the Speakeasy app, and start your English learning journey.] Speaker C: Abhi Speakeasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the Speakeasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: Speakeasy AI. Speak English Easily with Speakeasy. Install Now. GET IT ON Google Play.
summary: A train passenger unable to understand English directions is advised by a ticket collector to use the Speakeasy app. The collector explains that the app requires only 10-15 minutes of daily practice with an AI teacher and costs just 1 rupee to start. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app.
